title: A Filippov theorem for Volterra sweeping processes with one-sided Lipschitz perturbation
summary: We prove a Filippov-type stability theorem for integro-differential sweeping processes of Volterra type with an outer multivalued perturbation, in a separable Hilbert space, under the assumptions that the moving sets are uniformly prox-regular and Lipschitz continuous with respect to the Hausdorff distance and that the perturbation is one-sided Lipschitz.
